dataVisualization.maxSeriesColorsSource: Miller's Law — 7±2 distinguishable items in working memory (Laws of UX; Color Works Ch.3)
dataVisualization.minContrastBetweenSeriesSource: WCAG non-text UI element contrast minimum (Color Works; accessibility research)
dataVisualization.neverRelyOnColorAloneSource: 8% male color blindness prevalence; use patterns/shapes/labels as secondary cue (100 Things #34; WCAG 1.4.1)
dataVisualization.labelDirectlySource: Direct labeling eliminates legend lookup — reduces cognitive load (Refactoring UI; Edward Tufte principle)
dataVisualization.axisTypographySource: Smallest readable size for supplementary info (The Elements of Typographic Style, Bringhurst)
dataVisualization.gridLineStyleSource: Grid lines must recede visually — opacity + dashed reduces competition with data (Practical UI; Tufte 'data-ink ratio')
dataVisualization.chartTitleRequiredSource: Every visualization must announce what it shows — cognitive orientation (Don't Make Me Think, Ch.6)
dataVisualization.responsiveBehaviorSource: On mobile, reduce data points or switch chart type rather than shrinking (Practical UI; responsive data viz methodology)
